question: Who among the following retired from the position of Cabinet Secretary of India in August 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajiv Gauba**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajiv Gauba** retired as the **Cabinet Secretary of India** in **August 2024**. He was serving in one of the highest administrative positions in the country.
 
• The **Cabinet Secretary** is the head of the Indian Administrative Services (IAS) cadre and acts as the principal coordinator of all central government departments.
 
• **Rajiv Gauba**, a 1982 batch IAS officer from the Jharkhand cadre, was appointed Cabinet Secretary in **August 2019** and served for five years after receiving extensions.
 
• As Cabinet Secretary, he played a key role in coordinating policy implementation, managing crises, and ensuring inter-ministerial cooperation.
 
• During his tenure, Rajiv Gauba contributed significantly to initiatives such as **COVID-19 pandemic management**, national security, and economic reforms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Role of the Cabinet Secretary:**

 
 
• The Cabinet Secretary is the **highest civil servant** in the Government of India and serves as the top coordinator for central government functions.
 
• They act as the principal advisor to the Prime Minister and provide secretarial assistance to the Cabinet and its committees.
 
• The Cabinet Secretary is responsible for ensuring inter-ministerial coordination and resolving administrative disputes.
 
• This position is crucial for maintaining the smooth functioning of the **bureaucratic machinery** in India.
 
 
 
• **Tenure and Appointment:**
 
 
• The Cabinet Secretary is appointed by the Prime Minister and serves typically for a term of **two years**, with possible extensions based on performance.
 
• Extensions are granted by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC), chaired by the Prime Minister.
 
 
 
• **Rajiv Gauba’s Career:**
 
 
• Before becoming Cabinet Secretary, Rajiv Gauba served in various high-profile positions, including as the **Secretary of the Ministry of Home Affairs**.
 
• He has extensive experience in governance, policy formulation, and administrative leadership.
 
• His tenure as Cabinet Secretary was marked by major events like the **COVID-19 pandemic** and national-level reforms.
 
 
 
• **Other Prominent Cabinet Secretaries:**
 
 
• **Ajit Kumar Seth:** Served as Cabinet Secretary from 2011 to 2015.
 
• **Pradeep Kumar:** Known for his contributions in various administrative roles but did not serve as Cabinet Secretary.
 
• **TV Somanathan:** Currently serves as the Finance Secretary and holds expertise in economic policy but is not a former Cabinet Secretary.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Functions of the Cabinet Secretary:**

 
 
• Acts as the **chief coordinator** for policy implementation across central government ministries.
 
• Provides **advisory support** to the Prime Minister and other Cabinet ministers.
 
• Heads the **Indian Administrative Services** cadre and ensures smooth inter-ministerial coordination.
 
• Manages crisis situations and ensures effective administrative functioning during emergencies.
 
 
 
• **Rajiv Gauba’s Legacy:**
 
 
• Known for his proactive approach in handling crises like **COVID-19**.
 
• Played a significant role in coordinating **national security** and administrative reforms.
 
• His leadership style emphasized effective governance and policy execution.
